description: Catalog ambiguities and unconfirmed rules awaiting an official department or bylaw decision.
policyBody: The system never guesses or defaults a missing value. A gap stays open until a confirmed decision is recorded; the actual fix is a data change in the owning table.

stats.cohortsHint: Bylaws with at least one open gap
stats.linkedHint: Load-report rows on open gaps · {{resolved}} gaps resolved

failClosed: No fallback values are synthesized. Rules with open gaps fail closed.

filters.search: Search gaps by code, description or source…

protocol.title: Resolution protocol
protocol.subtitle: Resolving a gap needs a confirmed decision from the bylaw document or the department, recorded in the gap's notes.

noFallbacks.title: No heuristic fallbacks
noFallbacks.body: If a class size, credit cap or prerequisite is not stated by the bylaw, the system does not substitute historical medians or estimates.

failClosed.title: Fail-closed protection
failClosed.body: Students whose progress depends on an open rule are shown as unresolved cases instead of being given a guessed answer.
